cases.expectation_source: flaskr/blog.py index 路由渲染 blog/index.html 并传入 posts
cases.expected: 首页返回 200 且页面包含博客列表容器（如文章标题或空列表提示）

cases.expectation_source: blog/index.html 遍历 posts 渲染标题
cases.expected: 首页 HTML 中包含博客列表区域，且已发布帖子标题出现在页面中
cases.script_content:
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:5000"

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch()
    page = browser.new_page()
    resp = page.goto(BASE + "/")
    assert resp.status == 200
    body = page.content()
    assert "post" in body.lower() or "No posts" in body or "Log In" in body
    browser.close()

cases.expectation_source: auth.register 成功后 redirect 到 auth.login；auth.login 成功后 redirect 到 blog.index
cases.expected: 注册新用户后返回 302 重定向到登录页，随后用该用户登录成功并重定向到首页
cases.script_content:
import uuid
import requests

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:5000"
username = "u_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
password = "pw123456"

s = requests.Session()
r = s.post(BASE + "/auth/register", data={"username": username, "password": password}, allow_redirects=False)
assert r.status_code == 302, r.status_code
assert "/auth/login" in r.headers.get("Location", "")

r = s.post(BASE + "/auth/login", data={"username": username, "password": password}, allow_redirects=False)
assert r.status_code == 302, r.status_code
assert r.headers.get("Location", "").rstrip("/").endswith("") or "/" in r.headers.get("Location", "")

r = s.get(BASE + "/")
assert r.status_code == 200
assert "Log Out" in r.text or "logout" in r.text.lower()
print("register+login ok")

cases.expectation_source: base.html 根据 g.user 显示 Log Out
cases.expected: 浏览器中完成注册与登录后页面显示登出链接，表示已登录
cases.script_content:
import uuid
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:5000"
username = "ui_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
password = "pw123456"

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch()
    page = browser.new_page()
    page.goto(BASE + "/auth/register")
    page.fill("input[name=username]", username)
    page.fill("input[name=password]", password)
    page.click("input[type=submit]")
    page.wait_for_url("**/auth/login")
    page.fill("input[name=username]", username)
    page.fill("input[name=password]", password)
    page.click("input[type=submit]")
    page.wait_for_url(BASE + "/")
    assert "Log Out" in page.content()
    browser.close()

cases.expectation_source: blog.create 成功后 redirect 到 blog.index，index 查询所有帖子
cases.expected: 登录用户 POST /create 后返回 302 重定向到首页，首页列表包含新帖子标题
cases.script_content:
import uuid
import requests

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:5000"
username = "p_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
password = "pw123456"
title = "T_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]

s = requests.Session()
s.post(BASE + "/auth/register", data={"username": username, "password": password})
s.post(BASE + "/auth/login", data={"username": username, "password": password})

r = s.post(BASE + "/create", data={"title": title, "body": "hello body"}, allow_redirects=False)
assert r.status_code == 302, r.status_code

r = s.get(BASE + "/")
assert r.status_code == 200
assert title in r.text
print("create post ok")
